celestial_great_barracks_01 = {
	construction_time = slow_construction_time

	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = celestial_great_barracks_great_project_only_desc
			has_variable = great_barracks_construction_allowed # Only set by the construct_great_barracks great project
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		county.holder = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = celestial_great_barracks_enabled_desc
				OR = {
					vassal_contract_has_flag = celestial_military_appointment
					government_has_flag = government_is_administrative
					is_independent_ruler = yes
				}
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes

	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_2_cost

	character_modifier = {
		monthly_influence_mult = 0.05
		men_at_arms_title_limit = 1
		men_at_arms_title_cap = 1
		men_at_arms_recruitment_cost = -0.1
	}
	character_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_uses_governor_efficiency
		governor_efficiency_add = 0.05
	}
	duchy_capital_county_modifier = {
		stationed_maa_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.12
		stationed_maa_maintenance_high_modifier = -0.12
		stationed_maa_control_value_add = 1
		supply_limit_mult = 1
		garrison_size = 1.5
		hostile_raid_time = 0.5
		defender_holding_advantage = 15
		additional_fort_level = normal_building_fort_level_tier_6
		travel_danger = -30
	}

	next_building = celestial_great_barracks_02

	type_icon = "great_buildings/celestial_great_barracks.dds"

	flag = duchy_building
}
